summary: A complete single-player 24-seat battle royale loop (staging, skiff, glide, loot, fight bots, shrinking storm, results, requeue) on a procedural 1.2 km island, with a headless-tested authoritative simulation and a Practice Range.
notes: Runs fully locally (no server): the authoritative 30 Hz simulation is hosted in the tab, so networking, prediction, services, Rapier/Babylon/React from the brief are not built. Verified with headless Chrome (software WebGL) against the production build served from a sub-path; real-GPU performance and real pointer-lock feel were not measured.
